name: Drake's
why: Haberdasher wit — handmade East London ties to Somerset shirting.
origin: Michael Drake, East London, 1977 — handmade ties first; revived by Michael Hill and Mark Cho for the modern classical wardrobe.
opview: Positions itself as the well-made, easy-wearing modern classical wardrobe.

onething.n: brand calls them 'our signature Italian-made Games blazers'; collection page verified ✓

notes.style: haberdasher wit — the modern classical reference
notes.ivy: trad reborn with Italian cloth and a wink — the revival's house brand
notes.racquet: Haberdashery adjacent to the club rather than kit for it. The association is a way of dressing, and the sport is the setting that produced it.

cities: Chicago (Independence), Miami (Supply & Advise) · Mr Porter · own shop on Canal St
